The '''Sector Travel Guild''' was an organization that was involved in chartering travel throughout the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]]. They chartered travel from [[Grig Starport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]].<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
